Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().
Not a point where the laws break down: a point where there are no laws to break.$(br2)Made in $(item)Eschaton Foundry$().
The last ringing of a destroyed dimension, caught before it faded. It is the shape of the place, without the place.$(br2)Made in $(item)Eschaton Foundry$().
The end of all things, metered out in doses. What the last artefacts burn to stay what they are.$(br2)Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().
The end of all things, held still in a cage of Omnipotent metal. Every endgame artefact is built around one.$(br2)Made in $(item)Eschaton Foundry$().

$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Absolute Singularity$(): Echo of the Transcendental, Eschaton Cell, Eschaton Core$(li)$(item)Echo of the Transcendental$(): Eschaton Foundry, Rekindled Spark$(li)$(item)Eschaton Core$(): Eschaton Cell
Near the structures of impossible geometry - tesseracts, fractals, Calabi-Yau folds, event horizons - space itself bends on your screen. The $(item)Euclidean Anchor$() holds it flat.

Carry it anywhere in your inventory and use it to switch it on. While you are inside a distortion, the Anchor spends a little $(thing)Eschaton Charge$() to keep parallel lines parallel; outside one it spends nothing. An $(item)Eschaton Cell$() fills it again.
It is forged at the Omnipotence Core, from what the $(thing)Abnormality$() branch resolved.

The rebuilt Core does not simply make what lies beyond Omnipotence: it has to $(thing)simulate a universe$() in which the thing can exist. Its $(thing)FORGE$() page lists what it can forge and what that costs; beside it are the six constants of nature and six readings of the simulated universe.

Each recipe needs its own universe. Every constant moves one reading strongly and a few others a little, so tune them patiently: watch the bars, bring each to the middle. When all six are stable the recipe can $(thing)COMPILE$(). The Core remembers your settings while the game runs. JEI shows every Forge recipe.

Outside every universe there is a single, endless space. A $(thing)World Tree$() of an unknown material towers over it, uncountably tall at the very center.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): in Hyperdimensional Reality.

Its branches spread for more than a thousand blocks in every direction, and every branch carries $(item)Bubble Universes$() - entire cosmoses, each the size of a fist. Break one to take a sample.$(br2)Eternal inflation predicts exactly this: pocket universes budding off a larger space. I never expected to pick one.

$(item)Arbor Heartwood$() does not behave normally. It drifts between four phases:$(li)dormant$(li)$(thing)inverted$() - gravity reverses for whatever stands on it$(li)$(thing)luminous$() - blazing light, and it hurries you along$(li)$(thing)unreal$() - no light at all, and things fall as if through syrup

Below the Tree lies the $(thing)Ocean of Primordial Law$(). Laws bubble up out of it and pop out of existence again; anything that swims in it obeys whichever law is in force at that moment. Despite being a fluid, one can breathe within this liquid Law itself.
The fluid can be distilled. The Ocean yields $(item)Axiom Fragments$() and $(item)Crystallised Law$().
Made in $(item)Evolution Engine$().
An entire universe hanging from a branch of the World Tree, caught before it fell.$(br2)Made in $(item)Universe Forge$().
A shard of a foundational rule. Our understanding of Mathematics is built on these; thus in extention, so is reality.$(br2)Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().
A law of nature that bubbled up from the Primordial Ocean and frozen before it could pop.$(br2)Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().

$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Arbor Heartwood$(): Arbor Heartwood Sample, Arbor Simulacrum, Hyperreal Cache, Omnilex Casing, Omnilex Engine$(li)$(item)Bubble Universe$(): Arbor Simulacrum, Cosmic Flux Coupler, Omnilex Seal, Panspermia Seed, Transfinite Lattice Bolt$(li)$(item)Axiom Fragment$(): Absolute Notes I, Axiom Key, Axiomatic Field Emitter, Crystallised Law, Paradox Residue and more$(li)$(item)Crystall$()...

$(thing)Dimension data: Hyperdimensional Reality$()$(br2)$(thing)Nature$(): Gravity 1 g, 11 spatial dimensions, time x1, ordinary vacuum.$(br2)$(thing)Carry$(): $(item)Primordial Charter$() - with it, a new law every minute and a half.
$(thing)Landmarks$(): World Tree, Anomaly Vault Hyperreal Expanse.

The Omnium ingot is not hard because of one rare thing - it is hard because of $(thing)how much$() goes into it. The $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$() is a 9x9 crafting grid; JEI's "+" button fills it for you.

The $(item)Singularity Compactor$() swallows thousands of one material and squeezes them into a $(item)Material Singularity$(): 2,048 netherite, 8,192 diamonds, 65,536 redstone... There is no timer - it absorbs as fast as you (or pipes, or AE2) feed it, and remembers its progress.

Lattices of $(item)Cherenkov Lattice$() and nether stars make the $(item)Crystalline Matrix Ingot$(). Four "everything" items take one of every meat, every crop, a ring of ender pearls, and every music disc.
Tallying the totals. The $(item)Omniscience Catalyst$() takes one of every material singularity, the conceptual singularities, the four everything-items and more - roughly 587,776 raw items each.

The $(item)Omnium Ingot$() needs 16 catalysts, 32 Cosmic Neutronium, 16 Crystalline Matrix and an Omega Point in the 9x9 table.$(br2)In bulk: with $(thing)cosmic neutronium coils$() the Conceptual Singularity Compressor forges one from 128 catalysts and stacks of the late metals; with $(thing)transfinite coils$(), 4 at a time from 128.
Made in a crafting grid.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().
A metal made of every concept there is. The last ingot.$(br2)Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().
Diamond and Cherenkov quartz woven around netherite: a frame for a crystal that should not exist.$(br2)Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().
Lattices pinned in place by the light of two dead stars.$(br2)Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().
All nine singularities, fused. Holding it, you know everything - briefly.$(br2)Made in $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().

$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Extreme Assembly Table$(): Autonomous Extreme Assembler$(li)$(item)Omnium Ingot$(): Absolute Frame Casing, Apeiron Ingot, Axiom Key, Block of Omnium, Omnilex and more$(li)$(item)Cherenkov Lattice$(): Crystalline Matrix Ingot, Form of the Self$(li)$(item)Crystalline Matrix Ingot$(): Omniscience Catalyst, Omnium Ingot, Transfinite Weave$(li)$(item)Omniscience Catalyst$(): Omnium Ingot, Pleroma Confluence
A small indulgence. Working miniatures on pedestals: black and white holes, a wormhole, a pocket universe, a tesseract, a pulsar, a galaxy, a quasar, a Dyson sphere and a penteract.

They are drawn live, not painted. The ones that bend light (black hole, white hole, wormhole, pulsar) are the heaviest - their tooltips warn you. Only the nearest two dozen are drawn at once, so my shelf of forty never melts the renderer.

The research record of a civilisation that is encroaching the complete understanding of its universe. Its cover is primordial law itself, so the book reads like a document from before the universe decided its rules. It weighs exactly what I expect it to, which unsettles me more than anything.
pages.title: Absolute Dossier

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)To build the Omnilex Engine I needed a machine that knew everything I did. I bound the three absolute volumes over the unified dossier with primordial law, and for the first time the Research Nexus had nothing left to ask me.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Omnilex.
A frame that keeps its shape whatever the laws around it do: the one fixed reference in a place where every other measure has come loose.
pages.title: Absolute Frame Casing

pages.text: Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Omnilex.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Eschaton Foundry.

Cantor's absolute infinity: larger than every infinity, larger than any set that can be formed. By its definition, it should be beyond comprehension, and it cannot be conceived, yet here it is in my hand, without size or edge. Looking at it, my eyes slide off and I forget what I was counting.
pages.title: Absolute Infinity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Only the Omnilex Engine, simulating the World Tree and the Ocean of Laws together under a Primordial Law, could reach it. It added every infinity together and found one more on top. That was it.

Made in $(item)Axiom Distiller$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Transfinite Mathematics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Infinity, Absolute Notes III, Absolute Singularity, Arbor Simulacrum, Axiom Key, Cosmic Flux Coupler, Omniscience Catalyst, Omnium Ingot and more.

The first of the final volumes: axioms, paradoxes, the Banach-Tarski sphere that doubles itself, and Godel's sentence that says it cannot be proven. It is a notebook about the foundations of thought, written by someone standing on them while they shake.
pages.title: Absolute Notes I

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Omnilex required notes about the rules beneath the rules. I fed an axiom fragment, paradox residue, an axiomatic field emitter, a white hole fragment, a Banach-Tarski sphere and a Godel sentence into the line, and the first absolute volume came out signed.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Omnilex.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Dossier.

The middle absolute volume: crystallised law, a theory of everything, neutronium, the first uncountable cardinal, the E8 lattice and the Hopf fibration. It is where the most elegant structures I have found are set side by side, and it is beautiful in a way that makes me slightly afraid.
pages.title: Absolute Notes II

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I gathered the most symmetric things I had made - an E8 lattice, a Hopf fibration, aleph-one, a theory of everything and crystallised law - and bound them with neutronium. The Femtoscale line produced the volume that I now consider my best work.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Omnilex.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Dossier.

The last volume of all: the axiom key, absolute infinity, pocket universes, axiom schemas, epsilon-naught and an inaccessible cardinal. It ends where mathematics itself ends. I read it once, closed it, and went for a long walk.
pages.title: Absolute Notes III

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)For the closing volume I needed the largest objects I had ever handled - an inaccessible cardinal, epsilon-naught, absolute infinity - with an axiom key and an axiom schema to frame them. Pressed together with a pocket universe, they finished the record.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Omnilex.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Dossier.
Not a point where the laws break down: a point where there are no laws to break.
pages.title: Absolute Singularity

pages.text: Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Rekindling.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Echo of the Transcendental, Eschaton Cell, Eschaton Core.

Aleph-null is the size of the set of natural numbers, the smallest infinity. This shard makes it solid: a crystal whose facets can be counted one by one but never finished. It is cool and clear, and every time I count its edges I lose track at a larger number.
pages.title: Aleph-Null Shard

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I found one in a Hilbert Hotel, where every room was full and still had space. To make more, the Cantor Diagonalizer paired a Natural Number Lattice with its Power Set and a Superintelligence Core counted them.

Made in $(item)Cantor Diagonalizer$().$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Hilbert Hotel chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Transfinite Mathematics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Aleph Glass, Axiom Distiller, Banach-Tarski Sphere, Cantor Key, Conceptual Singularity Compressor, Continuum Shard, Dimensional Residue, Godel Sentence and more.

Amethyst shards compressed into a single violet point. It rings softly when tapped, like a crystal bell, and the sound seems to come from all around. Purple light refracts out of it in all directions.
pages.title: Amethyst Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Amethyst grows in geodes and chimes when struck. Feeding enough shards into the Singularity Compactor, I crushed them into a single ringing point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

Antimatter compressed into a single point without touching any matter, which ought to be impossible. It holds an almost unimaginable amount of energy. It glows faintly and must never be dropped. It is kept in a magnetic cradle and checked on more often than strictly necessary.
pages.title: Antimatter Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Antimatter annihilates on contact, so compressing it took careful magnetic fields. The Singularity Compactor eventually crushed the pellets into one point without letting them touch anything.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Exotic Chemistry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.
Anaximander's apeiron: the boundless stuff everything else is cut from. The ingot has edges only where you look.
pages.title: Apeiron Ingot

pages.text: Made in $(item)Transcendent Plasma Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Sundering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Frame Casing, Logos Coil, Logos Thread, Omega Simulator, Omnipotence Casing, Omnipotent Ingot, Pleroma Reconstitutor, Rekindled Spark.

The innermost wood of the Arbor, dense and pale, with rings that record not years but the branching of possibilities. Run a finger along the grain and it follows a different branch each time. It smells faintly of a vague rainy memory...$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): in Hyperdimensional Reality.
pages.title: Arbor Heartwood

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Arbor's core wood is different from its outer planks; the rings branch rather than circle. I cut a block from near the trunk and found each ring recorded a choice the universe had made.

Made in $(item)Evolution Engine$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Axiomatic Breach.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Arbor Heartwood Sample, Arbor Simulacrum, Hyperreal Cache, Omnilex Casing, Omnilex Engine.

Wood from the World Tree, the structure outside every universe on whose branches universes grow. Its grain holds contradictory properties: warm and cold, heavy and weightless, sometimes all at once. It smells faintly of rain in a universe that has yet to exist.
pages.title: Arbor Heartwood Sample

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Carving a piece from the Arbor Heartwood with my own hands, I expected the tree to resist. It did not. The sample came away clean, and it has not stopped changing temperature since.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Axiomatic Breach.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Evolution Engine, Omnilex Seal, Transfinite Lattice Bolt.

A shard of a foundational rule. Mathematics is built on axioms that cannot be proven but must be assumed, and reality appears to be built the same way. This fragment holds one of those rules, and when I hold it, I feel very sure of something I cannot name.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): dropped by the Law Wraith.
pages.title: Axiom Fragment

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Law Wraiths in the hyperdimensional reality drop these when they dissolve. In the Axiom Distiller, I learned to boil down a Primordial Law into its foundational assumptions and crystallise them.

Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Law Wraith.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Axiom Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Notes I, Axiom Key, Axiomatic Field Emitter, Crystallised Law, Paradox Residue, Primordial Charter, Primordial Law, Primordial Ocean Simulacrum and more.

A field emitter that projects not forces but Laws - a small region where a chosen axiom holds or does not. It is built on a graviton emitter with an axiom fragment, and it feels like holding a principle.
pages.title: Axiomatic Field Emitter

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Axiom theory showed that axioms can be distilled and edited. I mounted an axiom fragment on a graviton field emitter with transcendent metal, a horizon shard and a transfinite processor, and the emitter began projecting law instead of force.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Axiom Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Notes I.

A solid sphere that can be cut into five non-measurable pieces and reassembled, by rotation alone, into two spheres the same size as the original. It relies on the axiom of choice, and the pieces have no well-defined volume. It is perfectly smooth and quietly unsettling.
pages.title: Banach-Tarski Sphere

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Cantor Diagonalizer, I used an Aleph-Null Shard to choose a point from each of uncountably many orbits on a sphere. The choice split it into pieces, and when I put them back I had two.
Made in $(item)Cantor Diagonalizer$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Paradox Engineering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Notes I, Axiomatic Breach Engine, Banach-Tarski Sphere, Transfinite Casing.

Blue ice compacted into a single point so cold it frosts the air around it. Normal ice melts; this does not. It is perfectly clear and blue, and slides across any surface with no friction at all. Water that touches it freezes instantly into perfect hexagons.
pages.title: Blue Ice Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Blue ice is ice compressed until the bubbles are gone. Compressing it further in the Singularity Compactor gave me a single, freezing point that refuses to melt.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

A sphere of an entirely separate universe, nucleated out of the inflating vacuum and sealed off from ours. Inside it, the constants are slightly different. It floats in place and is faintly warm, like a tiny sun behind fog.
pages.title: Bubble Universe

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Eternal inflation predicts bubbles of other universes forming endlessly. I caught one at the moment it nucleated and found it would sit still in our world without expanding into it.

Cherenkov quartz compressed into one point, glowing the electric blue of particles outrunning light in a medium. It flickers as if something inside is still moving faster than its own light. It is the light of a nuclear reactor pool, held in one hand.
pages.title: Cherenkov Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Cherenkov quartz glows blue where particles move faster than light can in it. Compressing it in the Singularity Compactor focused that glow into a single brilliant point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

Chronosteel compressed into one point, its time-hardened structure collapsed together. Time behaves oddly around it, ticking slightly faster or slower depending on how you hold it. It is cool and dense and smells faintly of rust.
pages.title: Chronosteel Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Chronosteel is steel tempered in time. I compressed enough of it in the Singularity Compactor that its timelines merged into a single point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

An enormous pile of coal compressed into one point, pure carbon squeezed far past the pressure at which coal becomes diamond. It is jet black, and the stored chemical energy of ancient forests is almost palpable.
pages.title: Coal Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Coal is carbon from ancient plants, so I crushed vast amounts of it in the Singularity Compactor. It passed through graphite and diamond and kept going until it was a single point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

Every thought that could be thought, from a single neural lattice up to a superintelligence and a Boltzmann brain, compressed into one point. It feels attentive. Holding it, I am briefly aware of ideas I have not had yet, and then they are gone.
pages.title: Cognitive Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I fed every model of mind I had built into the Compressor, from neural lattices to general AI cores and holographic matrices. Thought itself collapsed to a single, watchful point.

Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Identity Kernel, Omega Simulator, Omniscience Catalyst, Ontological Junction, Proof of Everything, Spacetime Bearing.

Computronium compacted into a single point, matter optimised for computation crushed together. It processes constantly and feels warm with the heat of erased bits. It seems to be thinking about something.
pages.title: Computronium Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Computronium is matter arranged to compute as efficiently as possible. Compressing it in the Singularity Compactor gave a single point running more calculations than I can count.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

Housing for things that are not physical. Its plates are woven from transfinite structure and braced with formal proofs, so that what it contains is held by consistency rather than by strength. It is cold, perfectly regular, and slightly unnerving to look at for long.
pages.title: Conceptual Containment Casing

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Ordinary containment failed the moment I tried to compress an idea. I stitched a Transfinite Weave through Crystalline Matrix and a Category Lattice and sealed it with a Formal Proof Tree. Now the shell holds because it must, logically.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Paradox Engineering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Conceptual Singularity Compressor.

A shard whose size is that of the real line, two to the power aleph-null. Cantor guessed nothing lay between it and the countable infinity; Godel and Cohen proved the usual axioms cannot decide. The shard looks different every time you examine it, as if politely refusing to commit.
pages.title: Continuum Shard

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Taking the power set of an aleph-null shard should give the reals; it did, but the Cantor Diagonalizer refused to say whether omega-one fit between them. Dark energy kept it from collapsing while I waited. I also found pieces in the Ordinal Spire.

Made in $(item)Cantor Diagonalizer$().$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Ordinal Spire chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Transfinite Mathematics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Infinity, Axiom of Choice, Topos.

A great heap of copper crushed into a single point. It has a reddish glow, and electricity seems to pass through it without resistance. It is heavy and smooth and smells faintly of pennies. Verdigris never forms on it; there is no surface left to oxidise.
pages.title: Copper Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Copper is cheap and plentiful, so it was easy to feed the Singularity Compactor enough of it. The ingots collapsed into a single conductive point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

Cosmic neutronium compressed into a single point. It was already one of the densest materials I had, and now it is denser. The point is absolutely black and impossibly heavy, and space visibly dips toward it.
pages.title: Cosmic Neutronium Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Cosmic neutronium is neutron-star matter enhanced further. I crushed it in the Singularity Compactor, and it collapsed into a single point almost too heavy to move.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.
You see everything, because nothing can hide from what is outside it.
pages.title: Crown of Transcendence

pages.text: One of the four pieces of the $(item)Raiment of Transcendence$(). Each piece has its own gift; the whole set grants invulnerability, creative flight, and erases all dimension's laws effects on you.
Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().
The craftsman of the world had to hold it somehow. The only thing that can tune, wake or move an Omnipotence Core.
pages.title: Hand of the Demiurge

pages.text: The only thing that can handle a forged Omnipotence Core. Sneak and use it in the air to change mode:$(li)$(thing)Tune$(): turn the Core's resonance (sneak: the other way) until it is in tune with the place$(li)$(thing)Activate$(): wake a Core in tune - or let an awake one sleep$(li)$(thing)Move$(): lift the Core into your inventory (it must be tuned again where you set it down)$(br2)It does not work on the Core of the Transcendental.
Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().

A hoard of diamonds crushed into a single brilliant point. Diamond is already carbon at its hardest; compressed further, it becomes something harder still. It scatters light into every colour and is cold to the touch.
pages.title: Diamond Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Diamonds are carbon under pressure, so I applied more pressure. The Singularity Compactor crushed the gems into a single blazing point that scratches anything.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

Dilithium crystals compacted into a single point. They regulate high-energy reactions, and the singularity carries a faint thrum, as if still waiting to channel something. It glows a pale pink. Nearby energy seems to steady itself, as though being supervised.
pages.title: Dilithium Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Dilithium regulates matter-antimatter reactions. Crushing enough crystals in the Singularity Compactor, I made a single point that hums with stored control.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

Eleven dimensions, with all their compactified circles, branes and moduli, compressed into a point with none at all. It is impossible to say which way it faces. Even the space around it seems to lose a direction or two when it is near.
pages.title: Dimensional Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I gave the Compressor everything that held the extra dimensions in place: Kaluza-Klein shards, the dilaton, moduli, a D-brane, a penteract and a Calabi-Yau. Every dimension curled up until none remained.
Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Theory of Everything.
A singularity of something from another mod (or added by your pack).
pages.title: Singularity

pages.text: Echoes of the Transcendental, crossed and woven into a frame that remembers the shape of a world.
pages.title: Echo Lattice

pages.text: Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dodecaract Excavator, Hand of the Demiurge, Seed of Omnipotence.

Emeralds crushed into one bright green point. It is perfectly clear and seems to carry a faint scent of trade and villages. Light passing through it turns a deep, satisfying green. Every facet has merged into one, and yet it still seems faceted.
pages.title: Emerald Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Emeralds are beryl coloured by chromium. I crushed a hoard of them in the Singularity Compactor until the crystal lattice collapsed into one brilliant green point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.
Swing it and the world remembers how to decay. Any affliction, on one creature or on a place.
pages.title: Censer of Entropy

pages.text: Sneak-use to choose any harmful effect of any mod, its level (up to 255), how long it lasts (up to an hour) and the radius of its cloud. Use on a creature to lay it on; use in the air to leave a lingering cloud up to 48 blocks away.
Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().
The end of all things, metered out in doses. What the last artefacts burn to stay what they are.
pages.title: Eschaton Cell

pages.text: Made in $(item)Eschaton Foundry$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Rekindling.
The heart of every last thing. Forged by hand in the reborn Core - and once you have, the Eschaton Foundry can make more.
pages.title: Eschaton Core

pages.text: The heart of every endgame artefact, and of each creative item the Forge makes.

Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Censer of Entropy, Crown of Transcendence, Dodecaract Excavator, Equilibrium Lattice, Eschaton Cell, Euclidean Anchor, Ex Nihilo Engine, Greaves of the Absolute and more.

Exotic matter crystals compressed into one point. Exotic matter has negative energy density, and the singularity seems to push space away from itself slightly. It is faintly repellent to the touch. Dropped, it falls slowly, as though the floor were pushing back.
pages.title: Exotic Crystal Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Exotic matter holds wormholes open. Compressing it in the Singularity Compactor, I made a single point that pushes everything else away.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

Negative mass, massless alloy, antimatter, strange matter, dark matter: every substance that should not exist, compressed together. They ought to annihilate each other or fly apart. Instead they sit in uneasy balance, and the point seems to push and pull at once.
pages.title: Exotic Matter Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I gathered every form of exotic matter and fed them into the Compressor together, half expecting an explosion. Negative mass cancelled the rest, and they settled into one strangely stable point.
Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

Glowstone dust compacted into one point, glowing so brightly it is hard to look at directly. It is warm and seems to light everything near it. Its light flickers slightly, as if keeping time. Shadows do not quite form behind it, as if the light wraps round.
pages.title: Glowstone Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Glowstone gives off light without burning, so I wondered what happened if it was compressed. The Singularity Compactor crushed it into a point that shone far brighter than the original dust.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

A statement that says, of itself, that it cannot be proven. If the system could prove it, it would be false; so it is true, and unprovable. Godel showed every system rich enough for arithmetic contains one. The crystal reads differently each time and is always right.
pages.title: Godel Sentence

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Cantor Diagonalizer, a Superintelligence Core encoded a Formal Proof Tree into numbers using a Riemann Zeta Crystal. The diagonal of that encoding produced a sentence the core could not prove, and knew was true.

Made in $(item)Cantor Diagonalizer$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Incompleteness.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Notes I, Axiom Distiller, Axiomatic Breach Engine, Primordial Ocean Simulacrum, Russell Paradox Set, Topos, Transfinite Processor, Undecidable Kernel.

An immense hoard of gold, collapsed into one gleaming point. The warmth of the metal survives, and it gives off a soft yellow glow. Every ounce of it was originally forged in neutron star collisions, and now it is all in one place again.
pages.title: Gold Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Gold came from neutron star mergers, so it seemed fitting to crush it back down. The Singularity Compactor squeezed a pile of ingots into a single bright point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.
Distance is a law. You may keep it or not.
pages.title: Greaves of the Absolute

pages.text: One of the four pieces of the $(item)Raiment of Transcendence$(). Each piece has its own gift; the whole set grants invulnerability, creative flight, and erases all dimension's laws effects on you.
Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().
Its walls obey whatever law is currently in force. The contents, like infinitesimals beside the real numbers, sit at a scale no ordinary rule can reach.
pages.title: Hyperreal Cache

pages.text: Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Axiomatic Breach.

A tiny, dense seed that holds the minimal description of me - not the body, not the memories, but whatever remains invariant when everything else is stripped away. It is almost weightless and yet the hand closes around it reflexively, as if it knew what it was holding.
pages.title: Identity Kernel

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Transcendental dissolves anything that cannot say what it is. I compressed my own pattern through an ontological processor and a cognitive singularity, and anchored it to the omega point on a transfinite weave. What survived the compression was the kernel.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.

A mountain of iron, crushed until it collapsed into a single point. It is still recognisably iron: grey, cold and faintly magnetic. Holding it feels like holding the core of a planet, and it tugs at nearby metal.
pages.title: Iron Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I fed the Singularity Compactor iron ingots until their atoms could no longer stay apart. The pressure crushed them past degeneracy into a single dense point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

Kaluza-Klein shards compacted into a single point, their fifth-dimensional momentum crushed together. The point crackles with faint static and spins slowly around an axis that does not seem to exist in three dimensions.
pages.title: Kaluza-Klein Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Each Kaluza-Klein shard carries momentum around a hidden dimension. Compressing enough of them in the Singularity Compactor, I folded that dimension into a single charged point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

Lapis lazuli in such quantity that it collapsed into one point. It is a deep, perfect blue, and the colour seems to go down forever. Holding it feels cool and calm, like the bottom of the sea. Old painters ground this stone for ultramarine, the costliest blue there was.
pages.title: Lapis Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Lapis is mostly lazurite, a complex silicate. I fed the Singularity Compactor enough of it that the crystal lattice collapsed into a single deep-blue point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

A law of nature that bubbled up from the Primordial Ocean and froze before it could pop into a universe. It holds one rule completely, and nearby, that rule is slightly stronger than usual. Some feel heavier, some brighter; this one makes falling objects land softly.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): dropped by the Law Wraith.
pages.title: Crystallised Law

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Law Wraiths drop these when they dissolve. In the Axiom Distiller, I boiled a Primordial Law until one of its rules bubbled out on its own, and cooled it into a crystal.

Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Law Wraith.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Hyperdimensional Reality.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Infinity, Absolute Notes II, Contained Anomaly Specimen, Cosmic Flux Coupler, Local Law Violation, Omnilex Casing, Omnilex Engine, Omnilex Seal and more.
Blank, until you write. Then the place you stand in obeys what you wrote.
pages.title: Lawgiver's Codex

pages.text: Open it to rewrite the laws of the place you stand in: gravity, time and weather, which creatures may appear and how strong they are. Look at a creature while opening it to rewrite that creature too. "Restore" puts the natural laws back.
Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omnipotence Core.
A coil wound of Logos Thread, the word that puts things in order. Current through it does not so much make a field as insist on one.
pages.title: Logos Coil

pages.text: Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Sundering.
A strand of the Word that orders the world. Wound into a coil it makes space obey a shape.
pages.title: Logos Thread

pages.text: Made in $(item)Universe Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Sundering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Crystal of Transcendence, Echo of the Transcendental, Eschaton Cell, Logos Coil, Rekindled Spark.
Harm needs a law to happen by. You are wearing all of them.
pages.title: Mantle of Omnipotence

pages.text: One of the four pieces of the $(item)Raiment of Transcendence$(). Each piece has its own gift; the whole set grants invulnerability, creative flight, and erases all dimension's laws effects on you.
Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().

Netherite crushed into a single point. It is dark and dense, already the heaviest metal I had, now heavier still. It does not burn and it does not scratch, and holding it feels unshakeable. Lava slides off it and it stays exactly the temperature it was.
pages.title: Netherite Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Netherite is ancient debris and gold, already immensely tough. I fed what I had into the Singularity Compactor and it collapsed into a single, unbreakable point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

Neutronium is already matter at nuclear density. Compressed beyond even that, it is close to becoming a true black hole. The point is perfectly black and unthinkably heavy, and space seems to dip toward it.
pages.title: Neutronium Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Neutronium is what a neutron star is made of. Compressing it further in the Singularity Compactor brought it close to the Schwarzschild radius, and it collapsed into a single point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

Obsidian compacted into one point. It is black volcanic glass, already hard to break, now impossible. Its surface reflects things that are not there, and it is faintly warm, as if still cooling from the lava.
pages.title: Obsidian Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Obsidian is lava cooled too fast to crystallise. I fed the Singularity Compactor a quarry's worth of it, and the glass collapsed into a single dark point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

A complete simulation of the Ocean of Primordial Laws, the space where physical laws bubble up and fall back. It is still bubbling inside its lattice, each bubble a possible rule. When I hold it close I can hear it, flowing from a higher Dimensional space.
pages.title: Primordial Ocean Simulacrum

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Omnilex Engine first had to simulate the Ocean itself, using its own previous run as a seed under a Primordial Law. Each iteration added more bubbles, until the simulation was complete.

Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Omnilex.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Infinity, Arbor Simulacrum, Axiom Fragment, Axiom Key, Crystallised Law, Omega Point, Omnilex, Omnilex Seal and more.

The casing of the final machine: crystallised law and arbor heartwood bound over a transfinite casing with a transfinite weave. It looks like wood and glass and law at the same time, yet weights none.
pages.title: Omnilex Casing

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Omnilex Engine simulates the Tree and the Ocean, so its casing requires both. Arbor heartwood brought the Tree, crystallised law brought the rules, and the transfinite casing held them together.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Hyperdimensional Reality.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omnilex Engine.

A material that cannot be broken, as if a Law written within itself. Tools pass over it without effect. I have come to find it is not a Law to not be broken; it simply exempts a tool acting against it, and touching it feels like pressing against the end of an argument.
pages.title: Omnipotence Casing

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Found forming the walls of the deepest structures. I tried every tool and every machine I have. Nothing. I logged it as a boundary condition rather than a material.
Made in $(item)Transcendent Plasma Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Frame Casing, Eschaton Foundry, Pleroma Reconstitutor.
Omnipotence grounded into dust grains. Each grain can still be anything - for a moment.
pages.title: Omnipotence Dust

pages.text: Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Sundering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Apeiron Ingot, Eschaton Cell, Logos Thread, Omnipotence Casing, Omnipotent Ingot, Pleroma Crystal, Proof of Everything, Rekindled Spark and more.
Everything a Core needs to grow, folded small: a heart, a remembered world, and the proof that it can be done.
pages.title: Seed of Omnipotence

pages.text: Four of them go into an Omnipotence Core of your own.
Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omnipotence Core.
A splinter of the Core that made anything. It still remembers how - it has only forgotten what.
pages.title: Shard of Omnipotence

pages.text: What is left of the Core after the Shutdown Sequence. Once the Transcendental is rekindled, the reborn Core's Forge resonates more of them.
Made in $(item)Pleroma Reconstitutor$().$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Echo Lattice, Echo of the Transcendental, Eschaton Cell, Hand of the Demiurge, Rekindled Spark, Seed of Omnipotence.
A blade with no thickness and no limit. What it cuts has never existed.
pages.title: Omnipotent Edge

pages.text: Cuts through any armour and any invulnerability. Use: $(thing)Erasure$() - hostile creatures in a cone before you cease to exist. Sneak-use: $(thing)Chronal Stasis$() - time stops for every creature within 24 blocks for 10 seconds.
Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().
A metal that represents all that has been, is now, and will be, eternally. Forged at the reborn Core, out of the boundless and the dust of the old Core.
pages.title: Omnipotent Ingot

pages.text: Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Singularity, Dodecaract Excavator, Equilibrium Lattice, Eschaton Cell, Eschaton Core, Euclidean Anchor, Greaves of the Absolute, Hand of the Demiurge and more.
A solid cube of the metal that is every metal at once. It weighs exactly what I expect it to weigh, whatever that is, and it rings with every resonant frequency simultaneously.
pages.title: Block of Omnium

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I ran out of room for omnium ingots and pressed them together on a whim. They fused seamlessly, but taking them apart proved my attempt at saving space has been costly.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Omnilex.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omnipotence Casing, Omnium Ingot, Rekindled Spark, Transcendent Cache.

The last word in storage. Omnium lines the walls, the Omega Point sits at its heart, and the energy inside no longer obeys the usual bookkeeping. It is calm, featherlight, and seems to remember every charge it has held.
pages.title: Omnium Energy Cell

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Beyond the singularity cell there was nowhere left to store energy, except at the end of everything. Binding an Omega Point to omnium gave me a cell that holds what the universe will eventually amount to.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Omnilex.

A metal made of every concept, every material and every law, distilled into one bar. It has every property and none of them, depending on what you need. It is warm, cold, light and heavy at once, and feels like the end of the line.
pages.title: Omnium Ingot

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Omnium block was too dense to shape, so I cracked a single ingot back out of it at the crafting grid. Whatever else I make from here, it starts with this.

Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Omnilex.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Frame Casing, Apeiron Ingot, Axiom Key, Block of Omnium, Omnilex, Omnipotence Dust, Omnium Energy Cell.

A hoard of Omnium Ingots crushed into a single point, every concept compressed into one place. There is nothing left beyond it to compress it into. It is everything and nothing, and holding it feels final.
pages.title: Omnium Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I fed the Singularity Compactor Omnium Ingots until even they collapsed. The result was a point containing everything there is. I am not sure there is anything left to build.
Creative mode only. Use inside one of Alpha Omega's trial chambers to have it count as solved.
pages.title: Oracle's Lemma

pages.text: $(thing)Creative mode only$(). Used inside one of Alpha Omega's trial chambers, the chamber counts as solved - for pack makers and testers. It cannot be crafted and the Core refuse to make this.
Pleroma - the fullness. Every law the Transcendental held, frozen into one lattice.
pages.title: Pleroma Crystal

pages.text: Made in $(item)Reality Compiler$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Sundering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Crystal of Transcendence, Echo of the Transcendental, Omnipotent Ingot, Pleroma Glass, Pleroma Reconstitutor, Rekindled Spark.
Named for the Gnostics' Pleroma, the fullness of all that is. Light passes through it; nothing else is allowed to.
pages.title: Pleroma Glass

pages.text: Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Sundering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Eschaton Foundry.

Prime shards compressed into one point. Primes cannot be divided, and the singularity seems to have inherited that indivisibility. It is perfectly smooth and cannot be split or cut by anything. Every attempt to halve it simply returns the whole thing again.
pages.title: Prime Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Primes cannot be factored, so I wondered if they could be compressed. The Singularity Compactor forced countless shards into one point that is still, somehow, prime.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

A sheet of crystal on which the laws of physics are written as they were before any symmetry broke - one force, no masses, nothing yet decided. Reading it is like looking at the draft of a finished book that every later amendment has forgotten. Its edges are perfectly sharp.
pages.title: Primordial Charter

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Hyperdimensional Reality kept rewriting me to fit its own laws. I wove axiom fragments and a source code fragment through a transfinite weave and pinned it with a reality anchor, hoping a copy of the original laws would remind the place who I was. It did.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Axiom Theory.

The substance of law itself, before any particular law. It has no temperature and no fixed form, and it reshapes itself to fit whatever rule is asked of it. It is clear, cold and utterly still until disturbed.
pages.title: Primordial Law

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Simulating the Tree and the Ocean in the Omnilex Engine, I found the simulations produced a residue that was neither matter nor energy, but rule. Primordial law, distilled from the simulation of law.

Made in $(item)Axiom Distiller$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Hyperdimensional Reality.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Dossier, Absolute Infinity, Absolute Notes I, Absolute Notes II, Absolute Notes III, Arbor Heartwood, Arbor Simulacrum, Axiom Fragment and more.

Every possible state of every quantum system, in superposition and compressed to one point. It is not in any definite state, and looking at it seems to collapse it differently each time. It flickers between being there and not.
pages.title: Quantum Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I compressed the wavefunction, superpositions, entangled pairs, wave packets, spinors and fields together. Every possible outcome fell into the same point without any of them being chosen.
Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Spacetime Bearing, Theory of Everything.

Nether quartz crushed into one point, its crystal lattice compressed until it has no edges at all. It is milky white and faintly warm. Squeezing it seems to produce a tiny piezoelectric spark. Every vibration in the room seems to pass through it and come out sharper.
pages.title: Quartz Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Quartz becomes electric when squeezed, so I squeezed as much as I could in the Singularity Compactor. The crystals collapsed together into a single, faintly charged point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

Redstone dust in such quantity that it collapsed into a single point. It glows a pulsing red and seems to carry a faint signal, as though waiting to switch something on. Its warmth fluctuates rhythmically.
pages.title: Redstone Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I wanted to know what redstone's strange conductivity would do under extreme pressure. The Singularity Compactor crushed a mountain of dust into a single pulsing point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.
Four sparks of the second creation, beating together around an Eschaton Core.
pages.title: Rekindled Heart

pages.text: Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Hand of the Demiurge, Seed of Omnipotence.
What the Pleroma Reconstitutor leaves behind once the Transcendental is whole again: the first light of the second creation.
pages.title: Rekindled Spark

pages.text: Made in $(item)Pleroma Reconstitutor$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Sundering.
$(thing)Incompleteness$()$(br2)Any system strong enough to describe arithmetic contains truths it can never prove - reality included.
pages.title: Incompleteness

pages.text: $(thing)Insight$(): 400$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Transfinite Mathematics, Category Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Aleph-Null Shard.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Find the Gödel number of the symbol sequence with codes (a, b, c) = (3, 1, 2), using prime-power encoding.
$(thing)Paradox Engineering$()$(br2)Russell sets and Banach-Tarski spheres: building with contradictions.
pages.title: Paradox Engineering

pages.text: $(thing)Insight$(): 400$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Transfinite Mathematics, Causality Violation.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 8 Paradox Residue.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Show how many reduced words of length n = 5 exist in the free group on two generators, the engine of the Banach-Tarski paradox.
$(thing)Theory of Everything$()$(br2)Quantum fields, gravity, strings and the Standard Model as one theory.
pages.title: Theory of Everything

pages.text: $(thing)Insight$(): 500$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Conceptual Singularities, Grand Unification, General Relativity, M-Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 1 M-Theory Core.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Find the inverse strong coupling at the grand-unification scale Q by running it up from μ = M_Z with the one-loop renormalisation group equation.

The set of all sets that do not contain themselves. If it contains itself, it should not; if it does not, it should. Russell found it and broke naive set theory. In the hand it flickers between being there and being empty, never committing to either.
pages.title: Russell Paradox Set

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Cantor Diagonalizer, I fed a Godel Sentence, a Power Set and Paradox Residue together with Chronon Gas. The diagonaliser tried to decide what the set contained and produced this contradiction instead.

Made in $(item)Cantor Diagonalizer$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Paradox Engineering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Notes III, Dimensional Residue, Primordial Ocean Simulacrum, Transcendent Metal Ingot, Transcendent Plasma, Transfinite Casing.
A whole other world, run from its first instant to its last inside the Forge. Each mod has its own.
pages.title: Simulated Universe

pages.text: Each mod with creative items has its own, forged at the reborn Core from universe seeds, pocket universes, Omnipotent Ingots and that mod's own most advanced things. The Forge page shows exactly which.
It does not fire singularities. It decides where one has always been.
pages.title: Scepter of Singularities

pages.text: Use to put a singularity where you look, up to 64 blocks away; sneak-use to change which: Black Hole, White Hole, Tesseract, Entanglement, Big Bang. It never harms players.
Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().

Spacetime alloy crushed into a single point, its woven space and time folded inward. Distances near it seem shorter than they should, and time seems to skip. It feels slightly warped. A ruler laid beside it reads a slightly different length every time.
pages.title: Spacetime Alloy Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Spacetime alloy is metal woven with spacetime. Compressing it in the Singularity Compactor, I folded its spacetime inward into a single point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

All of relativity, from Lorentz transformations to the field equations and the stress-energy that sources them, squeezed into the one place where relativity itself predicts its own breakdown. Clocks near it disagree with each other, and straight lines bend toward it.
pages.title: Spacetime Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Relativity predicts singularities but cannot describe them. Feeding the Compressor every tensor and transformation I had derived, I let the theory collapse onto the exact point where it fails, and kept that point.

Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Singularity, Cosmic Flux Coupler, Ontological Junction, Theory of Everything.

Every quark flavour, every lepton, every force carrier and the Higgs, compressed past the point where they are separate particles. It hums with all the interactions at once. Small enough to vanish in the hand, it nevertheless feels as if it holds the entire periodic table in reserve.
pages.title: Standard Model Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I gave the Conceptual Singularity Compressor each generation of quarks, the leptons, the gauge bosons and the Higgs, and asked it to compress the zoo. The particles collapsed into a single point carrying the whole Standard Model.
Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Spacetime Bearing, Theory of Everything.

Star-forged iron compacted into one point. It is the end of fusion, now crushed even further. It is dense and dull grey, and carries a faint warmth from the stellar core where it formed. A compass needle swings toward it from across the room.
pages.title: Stellar Iron Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Stellar iron is where fusion stops. I crushed enough of it in the Singularity Compactor that it collapsed into a single point, the ultimate end of a star's life.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

Birth, life and death of a star, from protostar to remnant, in one point of light that never dims. Holding it is like holding a star's whole history: the warmth of fusion, the swelling of a giant and the cold heaviness of collapse, all at once and all faint.
pages.title: Stellar Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I loaded the Compressor with every stage of stellar evolution I had produced, from protostar core to supernova remnant. The stages merged into one luminous point that remembered all of them.
Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Cosmic Flux Coupler, Omniscience Catalyst, Ontological Junction.

Strange matter pellets crushed into a single point. Strange matter may be the true ground state of matter, converting anything it touches. This point seems eager, and I keep it well away from anything else.
pages.title: Strange Matter Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Strange matter could convert ordinary matter on contact. Compressing enough of it in the Singularity Compactor, I made a single point that is, so far, content to stay put.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

Conway built every number from two sets, a left and a right, and found that the reals, the infinite ordinals and the infinitesimals all fit into one ordered field. This gem contains all of them. It is impossibly dense, endlessly fine, and every attempt to find its edge reveals another number there.
pages.title: Surreal Number

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Cantor Diagonalizer was the only machine with room for this. I fed it octonions, the reals, an aleph-null shard and an infinitesimal, and let dark energy keep expanding the space between them until every gap was a number.
Made in $(item)Cantor Diagonalizer$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Transfinite Mathematics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Infinity, Unified Notes III, Well-Ordering Charm.

Tachyon crystals crushed into a single point that seems to arrive before it is placed. Tachyons move faster than light, and this point moves faster still. It is cold, faintly blue, and seems to be leaving.
pages.title: Tachyon Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Tachyons can never slow below light speed. Crushing tachyon crystals in the Singularity Compactor gave me a point that seems to be everywhere it will be, slightly early.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

Every moment collapsed into a single instant, with no before or after. Clocks stop being meaningful near it, and holding it gives a strange impression of remembering things that have not happened yet. It is perfectly still, and that stillness feels like waiting.
pages.title: Temporal Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Feeding the Compressor every time artefact I had built, from a backward arrow to a closed timelike curve, I compressed history itself. All the instants fell into one and stayed there.
Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Chronal Accelerator, Omniscience Catalyst.

The Standard Model, quantum mechanics, relativity, string theory, grand unification and M-theory written as one equation. It is short, symmetric and almost embarrassingly simple, and it describes every interaction there is. Holding it, nothing feels mysterious, briefly.
pages.title: Theory of Everything

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I fed the Compressor the singularities of the Standard Model, spacetime, quantum mechanics and the extra dimensions, plus the unified cores. All that I have come to known, all the theories ever conceived managed to merge. What remained fit on a single line, an equation that described all possible states of our universe.
Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Theory of Everything.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Notes II, Cosmic Flux Coupler, Omniscience Catalyst.
A crystal that has stepped outside every system that could describe it.
pages.title: Crystal of Transcendence

pages.text: Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().

Glass that is transparent to more than light. Looking through it, I see the room beyond and, faintly, the rules that make the room possible. It is smooth, slightly warm, and has no detectable thickness.
pages.title: Transcendent Glass

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Turned up beside transcendent stone at the edge of reality. It frames a view nicely, so I use it for windows where I want to remember what I am standing inside.
Made in $(item)Transcendent Plasma Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Sundering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Pleroma Glass.

This rock that no longer remembers which universe formed it. It has the solid presence of stone but none of the expected minerals, and its surface shifts colour faintly with my mood. Building with it feels less like stacking blocks and more like stating facts.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): in the Transcendental.
pages.title: Transcendent Stone

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Found lining the regions beyond the last physical layer. It cuts cleanly and holds a shape, so I started using it for walls. Practical, if philosophically suspicious.
Made in $(item)Transcendent Plasma Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Sundering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Transcendent Cache.
The last ringing of a destroyed dimension, caught before it faded. It is the shape of the place, though with the origin gone.
pages.title: Echo of the Transcendental

pages.text: Made in $(item)Eschaton Foundry$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Rekindling.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Eschaton Foundry, Rekindled Spark.

A casing built to hold infinities: a transfinite weave over reality lattice casing, with a Russell set and a Banach-Tarski sphere worked into the seams. It looks smaller from the inside than the outside, and larger from the side.
pages.title: Transfinite Casing

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Axiomatic Breach Engine leaked infinities into everything near it. I used a Banach-Tarski sphere, which can be doubled, and a Russell set, which contains itself awkwardly, as a frame that would accept anything, including Infinities itself.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Paradox Engineering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Axiomatic Breach Engine, Conceptual Containment Casing, Omnilex Casing.

The seventh tier of processor. It completes infinitely many operations in finite time, a supertask like Zeno's runner who halves each step. An aleph-null shard keeps count and a Godel sentence marks the limits it cannot pass. It is perfectly silent.
pages.title: Transfinite Processor

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)On the Femtoscale Assembly Line, I paired an Ontological Processor with an Aleph-Null Shard and a Godel Sentence. It ran an infinite loop, finished, and reported the answer before I had asked.

Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Incompleteness.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Notes I, Axiom Key, Axiomatic Field Emitter, Omnilex Engine, Omnilex Seal, Transfinite Lattice Bolt.

A cloth woven with more threads than there are natural numbers to count them - an uncountable weave in the honest Cantorian sense. It drapes like silk, and every thread is visible no matter how close I look. The endgame assemblies are stitched on it.
pages.title: Transfinite Weave

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Cantor showed some infinities are larger than others. I used an aleph-null shard as the warp and let a cosmic processor diagonalise across it to produce the weft. The result was a cloth that cannot be listed.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Transfinite Mathematics.
Every step lands. None of them fall.
pages.title: Treads of Infinity

pages.text: One of the four pieces of the $(item)Raiment of Transcendence$(). Each piece has its own gift; the whole set grants invulnerability, creative flight, and erases all dimension's laws effects on you.
Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().

A complete simulation of the World Tree, branch by branch, universe by universe, running inside a lattice small enough to carry. Every possible universe grows on it, and every one is real enough to compute. Looking into it is like looking down from a great height.
pages.title: Arbor Simulacrum

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Omnilex Engine needed to understand the Tree to control it. It simulated the Primordial Ocean under a Primordial Law, and from that the Tree grew in simulation, one branch at a time.

Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Axiomatic Breach.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Infinity, Arbor Simulacrum, Axiom Key, Bubble Universe, Omega Point, Omnilex, Omnilex Seal, Pocket Universe and more.

Everything I know up to the brink of pure mathematics, pressed into one volume until the separate fields are no longer separable. The pages are slightly damp with synaptic fluid, as if the book had been thinking. Opening it anywhere lands on something connected to everything else.
pages.title: Unified Dossier

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Learning to compress a whole field into one point taught me to compress my notes the same way. I stacked the three unified volumes on the theoretical dossier, soaked them in synaptic fluid, and the result read less like a book and more like a single idea.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Dossier.

The first unified volume, where infinity, hypernova metallurgy, reality anchors, geodesics and quantum superposition sit in the same paragraph without apology. Nothing here belongs to a single discipline any more. The paper itself seems to bend slightly along the lines of text.
pages.title: Unified Notes I

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Compressing a field into a point taught me to compress my notes too. Absolute infinity, a hypernova alloy ingot, a reality anchor, a geodesic thread, a superposition crystal and an eigenstate lattice went in; one volume of unified theory came out.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Unified Dossier.

The middle unified volume: countable infinity, catalysts of eternity, the Christoffel symbols of curved space, pocket universes, white holes, gravitons. Every page cross-references three others. It is a delight to read and almost impossible to summarise.
pages.title: Unified Notes II

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I bound an aleph-null shard to a Christoffel symbol and a pocket universe to a white hole fragment, with an eternity catalyst and a graviton crystal to hold the threads. The Femtoscale line found the common thread I had been sensing for months.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Unified Dossier.

The last unified volume: surreal numbers, the omega point, degenerate matter, the stress-energy tensor, causal loops with no origin, magnetic monopoles. It is where my notes stop distinguishing between what is true of matter and what is true of number.
pages.title: Unified Notes III

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)To close the unified record I needed the strangest proofs I owned: a surreal number, the omega point, a bootstrap artifact that has no beginning, a stress-energy tensor, degenerate matter and a monopole. Woven together, they read as a single theory.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Unified Dossier.

Void lattice crushed into one point. It is made of crystallised emptiness, and compressing nothing turns out to yield something very strange. The point is hard to look at, because there is nothing there to focus on.
pages.title: Void Lattice Singularity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Void lattice is a crystal of the vacuum. Compressing it in the Singularity Compactor, I expected nothing; I got a point that seemed to absorb its surroundings.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

A pendant of nested rings, each smaller than the one before, with no ring missing yet has an end. It embodies the well-ordering principle: every non-empty set of ordinals has a least element, so every descending chain must stop. In a place full of infinities, it is comforting to wear a guarantee of a bottom.
pages.title: Well-Ordering Charm

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Transfinite Hierarchy kept dropping me into staircases that went down forever. I set a surreal number inside rings cut from a power set and an aleph-null shard, and the charm forced every descent to end. I have not fallen forever since.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Transfinite Mathematics.

Runs the whole confrontation with Alpha Omega again - inside a model of it. Shown one Proof of Everything as a template, it walks the argument once more and writes out another copy.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 7$() machine.
pages.title: Omega Simulator

pages.text: $(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Makes more $(item)Proofs of Everything$() without fighting Alpha Omega again: keep one Proof in it as the template (never used up) and feed it Omnipotence Dust and the stuff of the argument.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (6 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Proof of Everything.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().
It simulates the World Tree and the Ocean of Primordial Law - and so controls them. Only works in Hyperdimensional Reality Space.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 8$() machine.
pages.title: Omnilex Engine

pages.text: Too complex for any crafting grid. I built this controller on the $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$() - check JEI for the exact parts; I needed every one of them.

This engine will only run in $(thing)Hyperdimensional Reality Space$(), and is built partly from the World Tree itself. It simulates the $(thing)Tree$() and the $(thing)Ocean$() - first separately as $(item)Simulacra$(), then together.
A perfect model of a thing is, in the end, a handle on it. Whoever holds the resulting $(item)Omnilex$() is no longer bound by gravity.

pages.name: Omnilex Engine
pages.text: Cycling blocks: any of them fits (Interface Ports, higher coil/emitter tiers). Rotate, zoom and view layers in $(thing)JEI$().

$(thing)Machine data$(): a multiblock (16 item and 16 fluid inputs, 4 and 4 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Absolute Infinity, Arbor Simulacrum, Axiom Fragment, Axiom Key, Bubble Universe, Crystallised Law, Omega Point, Omnilex, Pocket Universe, Primordial Law, Primordial Ocean Simulacrum.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().
Control over every law and every universe. While you carry it, gravity is merely a suggestion.$(br2)Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().
The final goal: build the $(item)Omnilex Engine$() in Hyperdimensional Reality Space. Simulate the Tree as an $(item)Arbor Simulacrum$() and the Ocean as a $(item)Primordial Ocean Simulacrum$().

Then join them with an $(item)Omega Point$(). Tipler's Omega Point is the end-state where computation embraces everything - a fitting seal.$(br2)Hold the $(item)Omnilex$() and you gain permanent flight.

With the two simulacra the engine can grow new bubble universes, rewrite laws into crystals, or simulate everything that will ever be, down to the Omega Point.$(br2)Last entry for now, that should be the end of all that I can discover and know. However, the history of sciences shows otherwise, that I am confidently certain I am wrong.
Control over every law and every universe. While you carry it, gravity is merely a suggestion.$(br2)Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().
A complete simulation of the World Tree, branch by branch, universe by universe.$(br2)Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().
A complete simulation of the Ocean of Laws, still bubbling inside its lattice.$(br2)Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().
The final state of all computation. It already knows how this ends.$(br2)Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().

$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Arbor Simulacrum$(): Absolute Infinity, Arbor Simulacrum, Axiom Key, Bubble Universe, Omega Point and more$(li)$(item)Primordial Ocean Simulacrum$(): Absolute Infinity, Arbor Simulacrum, Axiom Fragment, Axiom Key, Crystallised Law and more$(li)$(item)Omega Point$(): Identity Kernel, Omega Simulator, Omnilex Engine, Omniscience Catalyst, Omnium Energy Cell and more

A note scrawled in the margin, in a hand that might be mine: $(thing)the Omnilex remembers where it began - in the foam beneath everything$(). I do not know what that means. I do not want to find out.

Pour every fluid of this mod - and water and lava - into the $(item)Pleroma Confluence$(): $(thing)1,000,000 mB$() of each. Every other mod installed counts too, through its $(fluid)Essence$() (distilled in the $(item)Essence Distillery$()): $(thing)64,000 mB$() of each mod's Essence. The Confluence keeps a running total; when every one is full, 1,000 mB of $(fluid)Pleroma$() appears.

The old word means 'fullness': the totality of everything. Fitting. It accepts fluids from any pipe or AE2 on any side, and Pleroma can be drained from any side. Its screen (and JEI) shows what is still missing.$(br2)Mine is fed by every tank I own.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().
Pleroma carried in a $(item)Containment Cell$(), like every fluid of the mod: fill it at a tank, empty it into one.

A cathedral of Absolute Frame and Pleroma Glass around a Logos-wound throat. Fed the Echo of the Transcendental and everything the Sundering left, it plays the echo back - until the dimension it remembers exists again.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 5$() machine.
pages.title: Pleroma Reconstitutor

pages.text: This controller is too complex for a crafting grid. Build it on the $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$() - check JEI for the exact parts.
Runs once: fed the $(item)Echo of the Transcendental$(), it rebuilds the Transcendental. Only works while the Transcendental is destroyed.

pages.name: Pleroma Reconstitutor
pages.text: Cycling blocks: any of them fits (Interface Ports, higher coil/emitter tiers). Rotate, zoom and view layers in $(thing)JEI$().
$(thing)Machine data$(): a multiblock (16 item and 16 fluid inputs, 4 and 4 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Crystal of Transcendence, Omnipotent Ingot, Rekindled Spark, Shard of Omnipotence.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().
The last ringing of a destroyed dimension, caught before it faded. It is the shape of the place, without the place.$(br2)Made in $(item)Eschaton Foundry$().
$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Echo of the Transcendental$(): Eschaton Foundry, Rekindled Spark

The reborn Core's Forge makes the last materials by hand, and after every forging it must re-seed its universe: three minutes before it compiles anything again. The $(item)Eschaton Foundry$() makes four of them in bulk - the $(item)Absolute Singularity$(), the $(item)Echo of the Transcendental$(), $(item)Eschaton Cells$() and the $(item)Eschaton Core$() - with a Rekindled Spark resting in it.

It costs far more than the Forge, and it only repeats: each thing it makes, its owner must have forged by hand at least once. Until then it reports $(thing)Forge it once by hand first$(). (The Pleroma Reconstitutor still makes Omnipotent Ingots, Crystals of Transcendence and Omnipotence Shards.)

Its physics is $(thing)Bekenstein's bound$(): a volume of radius R holding energy E can store at most S = 2πRE/(ħc ln 2) bits. Each forging needs a certain amount of information packed in - more energy, or more room. But the radius must stay outside the Schwarzschild radius 2GE/c⁴, or the energy is a black hole. The best forgings sit just outside that edge.
Once explained, an anomaly is not gone: it is a $(item)Resolved Anomaly$() - a law that was broken and now holds. The last things of all are built on them.

$(li)Eschaton Core: 4$(li)Echo Lattice: 6$(li)Equilibrium Lattice: 8$(li)Hand of the Demiurge: 8$(li)Seed of Omnipotence: 12$(li)Lawgiver's Codex: 16$(li)Euclidean Anchor: 24$(li)a forged Omnipotence Core: 32
So the Abnormality branch is not a side road: every Eschaton Core - and everything made from one - goes through it.

endgame/second_core.title: An Omnipotence Core of Your Own

pages.text: Once the Transcendental is rekindled, nothing the Sundering left is a one-off anymore. At the reborn Core's Forge, $(item)Shards of Omnipotence$() resonate into more shards, Shards replay the $(item)Echo of the Transcendental$(), and Echoes strike a second $(item)Rekindled Spark$().

They make the last things there are: the $(item)Rekindled Heart$(), the $(item)Echo Lattice$(), the $(item)Seed of Omnipotence$() and the $(item)Hand of the Demiurge$() - and, last of all, an $(item)Omnipotence Core$() of your own.
Nothing can break the Core: not a pickaxe, not an explosion, not a piston, not the Wither. Only the $(item)Hand of the Demiurge$() can handle it. Sneak and use the Hand in the air to switch its mode.

$(li)$(bold)Tune$(): opens the Core's attunement.$(li)$(bold)Activate$(): wakes a Core that is in tune, or lets an awake one sleep.$(li)$(bold)Move$(): lifts the Core into your inventory. Set down somewhere else, it must be attuned again.

Attunement is the hardest tuning there is. Every branch you studied has three parameters - 21 in all - and every place (world, dimension, spot) wants its own values. The screen only says how in tune each $(thing)branch$() is, never which parameter is off. All seven must reach 97% (Mathematics: all four lamps) before the Core can be woken. Hover over a branch's name for its rule.

Each branch behaves differently. $(thing)Chemistry$()'s reagents always make a whole. $(thing)Biology$() measures what its parameters settle into together. $(thing)Mathematics$() is exact: congruences and a prime. $(thing)Origin$()'s phases wrap round, each counting from the one before. $(thing)Finality$()'s entropy creeps up while you work.

Contain $(thing)Abnormality$() first: while it is loose it spreads into the other branches, nudging them, and clouds every other reading. And the branches lean on each other in a ring - Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Origin, Finality, Abnormality - so settling one moves where the next one wants to be. Go round more than once.

Asleep, the Core is dim and seven faint motes drift slowly round it, one for each branch it must be attuned in. Woken, it flares: the motes race, golden rings turn about it and light rises and falls from it.
An awake Core works like the one in the Transcendental, wherever it stands: Materialize and the Forge. It has no Shutdown Sequence. Changing its attunement out of tune puts it back to sleep.

The rebuilt Core does not grant Creative power without proving yourself. To forge one of such item, it must first simulate the universe that item belongs to - the whole of that mod, from its first instant to its last.
