Each mod with creative items has a $(item)Simulated Universe$() of its own, forged from universe seeds, pocket universes and Omnipotent Ingots - and from that mod's own most advanced things (the Forge shows which). Then each creative item asks for its universe, an Eschaton Core, the best ordinary version of itself, and the material that fits what it does: pocket universes for storage, false-vacuum membranes for tanks, negentropy for energy...
No two Forge recipes are the same. Simulated universes are beyond Omnipotence: the Core's "make anything" cannot make them.
The reborn Core's screen has a $(thing)Forge$() page. Its recipes take materials from your inventory; it shows what each needs and what you have.

It makes the last materials - the $(item)Omnipotent Ingot$(), the $(item)Crystal of Transcendence$(), the $(item)Absolute Singularity$(), the $(item)Eschaton Core$() - and from them everything beyond Omnipotence. None of these can be given freely from the Core as these exist as an authority beyond the Core.

After every forge, the Core needs three minutes to re-seed its universe before it compiles again. The same materials can be produced by machines - Omnipotent Ingots, Crystals of Transcendence and Shards (the $(item)Pleroma Reconstitutor$()), Absolute Singularities, the Echo, Eschaton Cells and Eschaton Cores (the $(item)Eschaton Foundry$(), once you have forged each by hand) - are cheaper here, but a universe tuned for one of them is $(thing)spent$() by forging it: its laws drifts once more. For better quantity, build the machines.

The $(item)Pleroma Reconstitutor$() is the largest machine there is: seventeen blocks in every direction. Fed the $(item)Echo of the Transcendental$() and the rest of the Sundering's materials, it plays the echo back.
When it finishes, the Transcendental exists again, rebuilt as it was, and everyone learns $(thing)The Rekindling$(). The reborn Core keeps its Omnipotence - and gains a $(thing)Forge$().

The Rekindling happens once in a world: the Reconstitutor only plays the Echo back while there is no Transcendental. Its screen says why it waits - the Transcendental still stands, is still coming apart, or was already rekindled.

Afterwards the machine is far from idle. Keep the $(item)Rekindled Spark$() in it (it is never used up) and it plays back the Echo's $(thing)harmonics$() - the Forge's last materials, made by a machine instead of by hand, and some in greater yield:$(li)$(item)Omnipotent Ingot$() x3$(li)$(item)Crystal of Transcendence$()$(li)$(item)Shards of Omnipotence$() x3$(li)$(item)Absolute Singularity$()$(li)another $(item)Echo of the Transcendental$()$(li)$(item)Eschaton Cells$() x4
Each harmonic rings at its own frequency: set the drive onto the $(thing)Echo frequency$() the recipe names (JEI shows it), and give it the playback power its window asks for.

The Omnipotence Core can make anything - except what lies beyond Omnipotence. To go further you must force its reconstruction.$(br2)Its screen has a $(thing)Shutdown Sequence$(). Once initiated, it cannot be stopped: in sixty seconds the Core releases every law it holds, and the Transcendental disintegrates from the rim inwards.

Anyone still there is carried out at the end. Afterwards nobody can enter the Transcendental at all.$(br2)Whoever began the sequence receives what is left: $(item)Shards of Omnipotence$() and the $(item)Echo of the Transcendental$(). Everyone learns $(thing)The Sundering$().
This is not the end of the road: see $(l:endgame/beyond_the_shutdown)Beyond the Shutdown$() for where it leads - the Rekindling, the Forge and the last things.

The old machines can work with the shards:$(li)$(item)Omnipotence Dust$() - Concept Compressor$(li)$(item)Apeiron Ingot$() - Transcendent Plasma Forge$(li)$(item)Pleroma Crystal$() - Reality Compiler$(li)$(item)Logos Thread$() - Universe Forge

Omnipotence does not run out: with one Shard kept in the Concept Compressor as a seed (it is never used up), $(item)Omnipotence Dust$() condenses out of Pleroma onto omnium - as much as you can feed it.$(br2)More $(item)Proofs of Everything$() come from the $(item)Omega Simulator$(), which replays the fight with Alpha Omega using one Proof as its template.$(br2)From them: $(item)Absolute Frame Casing$(), $(item)Logos Coil$() and $(item)Pleroma Glass$() - the parts of the $(item)Pleroma Reconstitutor$().

Beyond every universe, beyond even Hyperdimensional Reality, lies the $(thing)Transcendental$(). The way in is made, not found: with the $(item)Proof of Everything$() and $(thing)Beyond the Omega$() researched, the $(item)Omnilex Engine$() does the impossible and collapses into a five-dimensional $(thing)hyperobject$(). It consumes its own structure, then drags in everything nearby; whoever reaches its heart is carried across.

The hyperobject stays where the engine stood, a doorway that pulls only those who come close.$(br2)The first arrival builds the place: a disc of transcendent stone a hundred and twelve blocks across, a Hall of Matter on its pedestals, eight reliquaries holding the controllers of the great machines of the endgame, and a rift back to the Overworld. Carry an $(item)Identity Kernel before entry$().

At its centre, on a dais within eight omnium pillars, stands the $(item)Omnipotence Core$(). Its screen lists every item of every mod installed: $(thing)Materialize$() any of them, as many as a stack, as often as you like.

$(thing)Access denied$(): the Core lists everything of $(thing)this$() mod too, but will not make any of it - ask, and it refuses. Nor does it make what lies beyond Omnipotence, nor the creative items of other mods (only the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$() makes those).$(br2)The Core cannot be broken, and nothing of Omnipotency can be built elsewhere. What comes next is the $(thing)Shutdown Sequence$().
Pair-produces antimatter from gamma photons and holds it in a magnetic bottle.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
pages.title: Antimatter Penning Trap

pages.text: Some basic physics: a gamma photon with enough energy can become a particle and its antiparticle at once - $(thing)pair production$(), E = mc² run backwards. Antimatter annihilates on touching anything, so a $(thing)Penning trap$() holds it in vacuum with electric and magnetic fields alone. Frequently check the seals as this must be precisely handled.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Annihilation Core, Antimatter Pellet.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().
$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Antimatter Penning Trap$(): Antiproton Decelerator, Penning Harness
Inverts the local arrow of time to harvest chronons.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
pages.title: Chronon Field Inverter

pages.text: Note to self: a $(thing)chronon$() is a hypothetical quantum of time, proposed in the 1920s and never adopted by physics. The arrow of time, though, is real: Entropy follows the rule of Thermodynamics, always increases and rises, and that is why the past differs from the future. This machine flips it locally and catches what falls out.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Causal Shield Lattice, Causal Solder, Chronon Capacitor, Chronon Gas, Chronosteel Ingot, Fractured Essence, Hawking Emitter.
Made in a crafting grid.
Gravitationally focuses the invisible halo surrounding every galaxy.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.
pages.title: Dark Matter Halo Collector

pages.text: Galaxies spin too fast for the matter we can see to hold them together. Something unseen supplies the missing gravity: $(thing)dark matter$(), about five times as much as ordinary matter, spread in a halo far beyond the visible disc. This collector gathers it - and the Nebular Gas my first stars are made from.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

pages.name: Dark Matter Halo Collector
pages.text: Cycling blocks: any of them fits (Interface Ports, higher coil/emitter tiers). Rotate, zoom and view layers in $(thing)JEI$().
$(thing)Machine data$(): a multiblock (16 item and 16 fluid inputs, 4 and 4 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Dark Matter, Exotic Matter Crystal, Nebular Gas, Void Essence.
Made in a crafting grid.

A small cloud of antimatter levitated in the middle of a Penning trap, held by electric and magnetic fields so that it touches nothing. If it did touch anything, both would vanish into gamma rays. Through the window it is a speck of light hanging very still, which is the reassuring part.
pages.title: Antimatter Pellet

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Firing entangled photon pairs into a heavy nucleus produced electron-positron pairs. With a superconducting coil and superfluid helium, the Antimatter Penning Trap caught the positrons before they met anything.

Made in $(item)Antimatter Penning Trap$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Antimatter Containment.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Annihilation Core, Anticarbon Crystal, Antihelium Nucleus, Antihydrogen, Antihydrogen Crystal, Antiproton Bundle, Antiquark Shard, Antisilicon Shard and more.
Proof that the improbable happens. For centuries every swan was white - until one was not.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): dropped by the Black Swan.
pages.title: Black Swan Feather

pages.text: $(thing)Dropped by$(): Black Swan.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Boltzmann Brain, Magnetic Monopole.

The third and final generation. The bottom is heavy; the top is as massive as a gold atom and decays before it can form a hadron. They are rarer than anything else in the Standard Model, and holding them feels like holding a pair of collapsing weights.
pages.title: Bottom & Top Quarks

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The second generation was not enough; colliding strange and charm quarks with pentaquarks in the Hyperion Synchrotron pushed collision energy high enough. Quark-gluon plasma caught the heaviest quarks before they could decay.

Made in $(item)Hyperion Synchrotron$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Standard Model.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Empirical Notes III, Higgs Boson Crystal, Standard Model Matrix, Standard Model Singularity.

An array of scintillator crystals and pixel trackers that records where a particle went and how much energy it carried. A quantum processor reads the flashes. The crystals glow faintly when hit. Tiny flashes ripple across it.
pages.title: Calorimeter Detector Array

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)To know what a collision produced I needed to measure both position and energy. I combined scintillators for energy, pixel trackers for paths and a quantum processor to read them.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Nuclide Forge, Particle Spectrometer.

Chronosteel threaded with stored chronons. Paradoxes that strike it are deflected into somebody else's timeline instead of mine. It is cool, faintly ticking, and slightly out of sync with the world around it.
pages.title: Causal Shield Lattice

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Chronon Field Inverter, I threaded Chronon Capacitors through Chronosteel with Chronon Gas. When a paradox hit the lattice, it slid off into another history and left mine alone.

Made in $(item)Chronon Field Inverter$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Chronodynamics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Anomaly Containment Ward, Causal Shielding Plate, Chronal Accelerator, Contained Anomaly Specimen, Entangled Bus Bar, Quarantine Field Matrix.

A container for chronons, the speculative quanta of time. If time comes in discrete ticks, those ticks can be stored and released, and this is the vessel. It pulses irregularly, slightly out of step with my own heartbeat, and it is wise to handle it before you use it, never after.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): dropped by the Paradox Echo.
pages.title: Chronon Capacitor

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Chronon Field Inverter let Tachyon Flux soak into a Tachyon Crystal, with a Qubit to count the ticks. Paradox Echoes drop charged ones; I took that as a sign the idea was sound before I proved it.

Made in $(item)Chronon Field Inverter$().$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Paradox Echo.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Anomaly Vault chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Chronodynamics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Arrow of Time Shard, Bioreactor, Brane Tether, Casimir Energy Cell, Causal Shield Lattice, Causal Solder, Chronal Accelerator, Chronal Anchor and more.

A gas of time quanta, if time comes in quanta. It drifts against the direction of other gases, and clocks immersed in it tick unevenly. Breathing near it leaves me unsure how long I have been standing there.
pages.title: Chronon Gas

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Distilling dimensional residue, one fraction made my clocks drift whenever it leaked. Chronons are only hypothetical, but whatever settled in that tier of the spire carried time with it.

Made in $(item)Chrono Loom$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Chronodynamics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Arrow of Time Shard, Bootstrap Artifact, Causal Shield Lattice, Chronal Accelerator, Chronon Gas, Chronosteel Ingot, Closed Timelike Curve, Contained Anomaly Specimen and more.

A casing laced with tachyon crystal and a chronon capacitor, so that time inside flows at a rate I can adjust. It feels slightly out of sync with the rest of the world, as though the hand touching it is one heartbeat late.
pages.title: Chronoplastic Casing

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Time-manipulating machines bled their effects onto their own housings. I built a casing whose clock could be set independently, using tachyons to reach ahead and a chronon capacitor to store the difference.

Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Chronodynamics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Anomaly Containment Ward, Causal Shielding Plate, Causality Loop Engine, Chronal Accelerator, Chrono Loom, Evolution Engine.

Matter that feels gravity but ignores light. Bottled, it looks like nothing at all; the flask is merely heavier than it should be. Galaxies are wrapped in halos of this, holding them together like an invisible net.
pages.title: Dark Matter

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Vera Rubin saw galaxies spinning too fast for what they showed. Sweeping the halo with the Dark Matter Halo Collector, I gathered something that registered only on my scales.

Made in $(item)Dark Matter Halo Collector$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Dark Sector.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Contained Anomaly Specimen, Cosmic Neutronium Ingot, Cosmic Processor, Dark Matter, Dark Matter Lens, Degenerate Matter Chunk, Dimensional Residue, Exotic Matter Singularity and more.

A lens that focuses gravity, not light. Dark matter does not interact with photons, but its mass curves spacetime, and this lens shapes that curvature into a focal point. It looks almost empty, a faint ripple in the air, yet anything placed behind it seems drawn toward the middle.
pages.title: Dark Matter Lens

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I wanted a way to concentrate the dark matter I had gathered. Wrapping it in Metamaterial Sheet around a Void Lattice Shard in the Metamaterial Weaver gave a lens that bent gravity itself into focus.

Made in $(item)Metamaterial Weaver$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Dark Sector.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Axiom Distiller, Cosmic Neutronium Ingot, Cosmological Constant, Dark Energy, Dark Energy Siphon, Dark Matter, De Sitter Horizon Shard, Dimensional Residue and more.

A superconducting dipole magnet on a neutronium frame that bends a charged particle beam into a circle. Its field is perfectly uniform across the gap. Metal tools drift toward it. Its field lines would draw a perfect rectangle in iron filings.
pages.title: Dipole Bending Magnet

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)A synchrotron needs magnets to curve the beam back on itself. I wound a dipole around a superconducting coil block on a neutronium plate and the beam turned exactly as calculated.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Antiproton Decelerator, Hyperion Synchrotron, Particle Spectrometer.

Superconducting cable wound into a saddle-shaped coil. Its magnetic field runs straight across the beam pipe and bends charged particles into a circle, as in every synchrotron. It is cold, heavy and slightly springy, frosted along its windings.
pages.title: Dipole Winding

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)To steer particles around a ring I needed a uniform bending field. In the Metamaterial Weaver I wound a Superconducting Coil over Neutronium Plate and metamaterial into a saddle, cooled in helium. A derelict station had one too.
Made in $(item)Metamaterial Weaver$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dipole Bending Magnet.

Two halves of a quantum pair, each locked inside a small housing. Whatever happens to one is correlated with the other, however far apart they sit. It is cold, quiet and faintly luminous at the junctions.
pages.title: Entangled Relay

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Entanglement cannot send messages faster than light on its own, but it does make two places share a state. Binding Entangled Photon Pairs with a quantum dot and a chronon capacitor gave me linked relays.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Chronodynamics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Entangled Transceiver.
A junction that keeps entangled pairs until they are wanted. Their correlations are perfect, yet no message can ride on them: no-signalling sees to that.
pages.title: Entanglement Node

pages.text: Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Dark Sector.

Matter with negative energy density, the ingredient general relativity keeps asking for whenever someone wants a wormhole or a warp bubble. The crystal tries to fall upward and slowly drifts toward the ceiling if I let go. Its facets bend light outward, as though the space around it were gently repelled.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): dropped by the Void Wraith.
pages.title: Exotic Matter Crystal

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)A Pocket Universe whose vacuum decayed unevenly left pockets of negative energy behind, and the Universe Forge froze them into these crystals. Before that I had only seen them shed by Void Wraiths, or sitting in anomaly vaults, quietly pushing the lid up.

Made in $(item)Universe Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Void Wraith.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Anomaly Vault, Bulk Monolith chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Dark Sector.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Alcubierre Coil, Dimensional Residue, ER Bridge Thread, Einstein-Rosen Bridge Projector, Entanglement Node, Exotic Matter Singularity, Exotic Solder, Negative Energy Lattice and more.

A picture standing for a term in the calculation of how particles interact: lines are particles, vertices are interactions. Sum all diagrams and you get the full answer. The diagram moves slightly, lines bending and joining as if acting out a process.
pages.title: Feynman Diagram

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Integrating over all the ways gauge bosons could interact with a quantum field lattice and a wavefunction, the Formal Proof Assistant returned a sum of diagrams, each a possible history of the process.
Made in $(item)Formal Proof Assistant$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Quantum Field Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Quantum Singularity.

A splinter of reality that broke away from a destabilised creature. It is in several places at once, flickering between them, and it is never quite where I expect it. It feels like a shard of glass whose edges keep moving.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): dropped by the Destabilised Husk.
pages.title: Fractured Essence

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I first picked these up after a Destabilised Husk came apart in front of me. The splinters kept flickering in and out of my pocket until I put them in a jar.

Made in $(item)Chronon Field Inverter$().$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Destabilised Husk.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Chronodynamics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Contained Anomaly Specimen, Degenerate Matter Chunk, Integer Ring, Strange Matter Pellet, Warm Helium, Xenogenome Sample.

Photon, gluon, W and Z: the particles that carry electromagnetism and the strong and weak forces. Each is the ripple of a symmetry in its field. The cluster is lively and restless in the hand, pushing and pulling in ways that do not quite add up to any single force.
pages.title: Gauge Boson Cluster

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Entangled photons gave me the photon; a glueball core gave me gluons; quark-gluon plasma at high energy supplied the W and Z. The Particle Spectrometer collected all four force carriers into a single cluster.

Made in $(item)Particle Spectrometer$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Standard Model.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Feynman Diagram, Higgs Boson Crystal, Standard Model Matrix, Standard Model Singularity.

Gluons carry the very colour charge they mediate, so in principle they can bind to one another with no quarks at all. This is that bound state: a knot of pure strong force, heavy and warm, with nothing inside it but the glue. Lattice QCD predicted it for decades; I am holding one.
pages.title: Glueball Core

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I stripped the quarks out of a quark-gluon plasma beam using strange matter as a sink and a qubit to tag what remained. Most runs left nothing. One left a dense, colourless sphere of self-interacting gluons that refused to decay.

Made in $(item)Hyperion Synchrotron$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Accelerator Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dimensional Residue, Gauge Boson Cluster, Hypernova Alloy Ingot, Transcendent Plasma Forge.

An excitation of the Higgs field, which fills all of space and gives particles their mass by dragging on them. Normally it decays in less than a zeptosecond. This crystal caught one before it could, and it is heavy in a way that seems to come from the field around it rather than the crystal.
pages.title: Higgs Boson Crystal

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Higgs couples most strongly to the heaviest particles, so I fed top quarks, gauge bosons and a Higgs field capacitor into the Hyperion Synchrotron. In the debris, a resonance I had been looking for froze solid.
Made in $(item)Hyperion Synchrotron$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Standard Model.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Higgs Catalyst, Standard Model Matrix, Standard Model Singularity.

A device that holds a local excitation of the Higgs field, the field that gives fundamental particles their mass. Inside, the field sits slightly away from its usual value, so objects nearby feel faintly heavier or lighter. It is dense, cool, and handles mass the way an ordinary capacitor handles charge.
pages.title: Higgs Field Capacitor

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)A magnetic monopole wrapped in a superconducting coil in the Topological Phase Transmuter created a tiny defect in the vacuum. The Higgs field pooled around it, and with a qubit and a condensate I learned to store that excitation.

Made in $(item)Topological Phase Transmuter$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Attoscale Capacitor, Dyson Shell Segment, Higgs Boson Crystal, Higgs Catalyst, Higgs Field Modulator, Metastable Vacuum Lattice, Stellar Frame Casing.

Baryons in which at least one ordinary quark has been swapped for a strange one: lambdas, sigmas, xis, packed into a lattice. Strangeness adds mass and a slow, stubborn weak decay that these crystals simply postpone. The faces are cold, the inside feels heavier than the outside, and it is never quite still.
pages.title: Hyperon Crystal

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Feeding strange matter and a sterile neutrino through the synchrotron, I tried to coax strange quarks into ordinary baryons. Tachyon crystal stretched the decay clock long enough for the hyperons to settle into a lattice instead of decaying.

Made in $(item)Hyperion Synchrotron$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Accelerator Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dimensional Residue, Empirical Notes I, Graviton Field Emitter, Hypernova Alloy Ingot, Transcendent Metal Ingot, Transcendent Plasma, Transcendent Plasma Forge, Transfinite Coil Block.

Electron, muon and tau, three charged leptons differing only in mass, each paired with its own neutrino. None of them feel the strong force. The triplet hangs together loosely, and the neutrinos seem to drift straight through my hand without noticing.
pages.title: Lepton Triplet

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Neutrino flux passes through almost everything, so I used a sterile neutrino as a bait and antimatter to tag charged partners. The Particle Spectrometer separated three charged leptons, each shadowed by its neutrino flavour.
Made in $(item)Particle Spectrometer$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Standard Model.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Standard Model Matrix, Standard Model Singularity.

A magnet with only one pole. Maxwell's equations would be beautifully symmetric if these existed, and Dirac showed a single one anywhere would explain why electric charge comes in fixed units. A compass near it points straight at it, no matter where I stand.
pages.title: Magnetic Monopole

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Smashing Quark-Gluon Plasma in the Quark-Gluon Collider, I aimed a superconducting coil at the debris. One particle threaded the coil and left a permanent jump in the current: the signature of a monopole, just as Cabrera once looked for.

Made in $(item)Pulsed Magnet Lab$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Attoscale Inductor, Dimensional Residue, Empirical Notes I, Exotic Matter Singularity, Grand Unified Core, Graviton Condenser, Higgs Field Capacitor, Higgs Field Modulator and more.
Casimir cavities stacked by the million: in each, the vacuum between the plates holds less energy than the vacuum outside.
pages.title: Negative Energy Lattice

pages.text: Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Dark Sector.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Warp Bubble Core, Warp Coil Ring.

Eight-dimensional numbers, built by doubling quaternions once more. Multiplication stops even associating, so the order you group products in matters. Yet every non-zero octonion still has an inverse; they are the last and largest normed division algebra. The crystal is beautiful and slightly unsettling to look at for long.
pages.title: Octonion Crystal

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Doubling the quaternions by the Cayley-Dickson trick needed room for eight dimensions, which a Calabi-Yau manifold and some exotic matter provided. A prime shard stabilised the multiplication table. Hurwitz says there is nothing beyond this that still divides.

Made in $(item)Peano Arithmetic Engine$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Abstract Algebra.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dimensional Residue, E8 Lattice, Functor Bridge, G₂ Manifold, Mathematics Singularity, Surreal Number.
Coils across the shoulders, electrodes at wrist and ankle, a faint blue hum. It holds a bubble of field a hair thick around the wearer, and nothing gets through it.
pages.title: Penning Harness

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The first step into the Antiverse lit me up like a flare. A Penning trap holds a cloud of positrons forever without walls - I scaled one up and wore it.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Chronodynamics.

A spindle built to couple with the ergosphere of a rotating black hole, the region where spacetime itself is dragged around so fast nothing can stand still. Penrose showed that energy can be extracted there by splitting objects. It spins freely and never seems to slow down.
pages.title: Penrose Spindle

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)A Kerr black hole wants to give away its spin. I built a neutronium spindle with a superconducting coil and a magnetic monopole at its core, so the frame-dragging could grip it and turn it directly.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Kerr Metric Shard, Penrose Ergosphere Generator.

Four quarks and an antiquark, bound into one hadron that real accelerators only glimpse as a bump in a decay spectrum. Here the bump has been frozen into a glittering shard. It hums faintly against the palm, as if the five constituents are still arguing over who holds whom, and the colour charge never quite settles.
pages.title: Pentaquark Shard

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Smashing strange matter into antimatter inside the Hyperion Synchrotron, I saw a resonance in the debris that matched no ordinary baryon. Pouring quark-gluon plasma over the collision point, then cooling it with entangled photons, let the five-quark state crystallise before it fell apart.

Made in $(item)Hyperion Synchrotron$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Accelerator Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Bottom & Top Quarks, Cosmic Neutronium Coil Block, Dimensional Residue, Hypernova Plasma, Residual Starlight.

A qubit-array sensor that records the exact path of every charged particle crossing it. Each pixel is a qubit that flips when a particle passes, and the trail of flipped pixels traces a track. It is flat, cold and delicate.
pages.title: Pixel Tracker Module

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I needed to see particle tracks, not just flashes. In the Femto Fabricator I laid Qubits and Quantum Dots on a Cherenkov Wafer with Superconducting Solder. Every passing particle flipped a line of pixels.
Made in $(item)Femto Fabricator$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Calorimeter Detector Array.

A hyperbolic pole piece ground to within ten nanometres of its ideal shape. Four of them together form a quadrupole magnet, which squeezes a beam in one direction while letting it spread in the other. Alternating them focuses the beam like a lens.
pages.title: Quadrupole Pole Tip

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)A beam spreads apart if nothing focuses it. In the Casimir Vacuum Press, I shaped Neutronium Plate against a Topological Insulator, using the vacuum pressure to grind the hyperbola exactly.
Made in $(item)Casimir Vacuum Press$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Quadrupole Focusing Magnet.

A field spread throughout spacetime, with particles appearing as quantised excitations of it. Every electron in the universe is a ripple in a single electron field. The lattice glows faintly and seems to ripple when breathed on.
pages.title: Quantum Field Lattice

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Placing wave packets and spinors onto a differential manifold and cooling them in a condensate, I found the Analytic Continuator could describe them all as excitations of one field.
Made in $(item)Analytic Continuator$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Quantum Field Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Coherence Stabiliser, Feynman Diagram, Quantum Singularity.

The state of matter that filled the universe for its first few microseconds. Protons and neutrons have melted, and quarks and gluons flow freely as an almost perfect liquid with barely any viscosity. It is the hottest thing I have ever bottled, and it pours like light.
pages.title: Quark-Gluon Plasma

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Colliding neutronium nuclei in the Quark-Gluon Collider, cooled with superfluid helium between runs, I saw jets quench as if passing through a thick liquid. The protons had melted. Heavy-ion physics in a flask.

Made in $(item)Quark-Gluon Collider$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Bottom & Top Quarks, Dimensional Residue, Exotic Solder, Flerovium Ingot, Gauge Boson Cluster, Glueball Core, Grand Unified Core, Hawking Radiation and more.

Hamilton's numbers: one real part and three imaginary units i, j and k, which multiply in a fixed cycle and do not commute. Swap the order and the sign flips. Rotations in three dimensions are just quaternion multiplication, so the crystal turns in the hand with an uncanny smoothness and never gimbal-locks.
pages.title: Quaternion Crystal

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Trying to extend the complex plane into three dimensions failed, as it did for Hamilton, until I added a fourth. A magnetic monopole supplied the twist that lets ij differ from ji, and the condensate held it steady.

Made in $(item)Peano Arithmetic Engine$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Abstract Algebra.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Empirical Notes II, Hopf Fibration, Minkowski Lattice, Octonion Crystal, Spinor Lattice.
$(thing)Grand Unification$()$(br2)At high enough energy, three forces become one.
pages.title: Grand Unification

pages.text: $(thing)Insight$(): 150$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Supersymmetry, String Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Superpartner Shard.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Find the inverse U(1) coupling at Q = 1e16 GeV, given 1/α = 59 at μ = 91.2 GeV and one-loop coefficient b = 4.1.
$(thing)Supersymmetry$()$(br2)Every boson has a fermion twin. The lightest of them is dark matter.
pages.title: Supersymmetry

pages.text: $(thing)Insight$(): 90$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): The Standard Model, The Dark Sector, Quantum Field Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 1 Standard Model Matrix.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Find the relic density of the lightest supersymmetric particle (a WIMP) from its annihilation cross-section.

A resonant cavity driven by a tachyon klystron that gives each passing particle a precisely timed kick. Inside, radio waves bounce in a standing pattern. It hums at a frequency I can feel in my teeth.
pages.title: RF Accelerating Cavity

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Particles in a ring need repeated kicks to gain energy. I built an RF resonator cell into spacetime casing and drove it with a tachyon klystron, so every kick arrived on time.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Antiproton Decelerator, Hyperion Synchrotron, Nuclide Forge.

A pill-box cavity of topological superconductor. A standing radio-frequency wave rings inside, and each bunch of particles that crosses it at the right moment gets a kick forward. It is small, smooth and cold, and hums faintly when powered.
pages.title: RF Resonator Cell

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)To accelerate a beam I needed a resonator with no losses. In the Lattice Growth Vat I grew a cavity of Topological Insulator and Cherenkov Quartz in superfluid helium. The wave inside would not decay.
Made in $(item)Lattice Growth Vat$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): RF Accelerating Cavity.

A crystal that flashes when a particle passes through it. Each flash is proportional to the energy deposited, so counting them tells me what was made in a collision. It is clear and slightly blue, and twinkles constantly from cosmic rays.
pages.title: Scintillator Crystal

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Lattice Growth Vat I grew Cherenkov Quartz with Quantum Dots in superfluid helium. Every passing particle lit a dot, and the flashes gave me a clear count of each collision.
Made in $(item)Lattice Growth Vat$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Calorimeter Detector Array.

Spinors describe electrons and other spin-half particles. Rotate one a full 360 degrees and it comes back with its sign flipped; a second full turn restores it. The lattice feels oddly twisted and never quite seems to have come back to where it started.
pages.title: Spinor Lattice

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Representing rotations with quaternions in the Peano Arithmetic Engine, I noticed each rotation had two quaternions, plus and minus. A qubit stored the sign, and the result behaved like a spinor.
Made in $(item)Peano Arithmetic Engine$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Quantum Field Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Eigenstate Lattice, Quantum Field Lattice, Quantum Singularity.

The second generation: copies of the up and down with more mass and new quantum numbers, strangeness and charm. Outside strange matter they decay in a fraction of an instant through the weak force. These are held together, faintly fizzing, as if impatient to become something lighter.
pages.title: Strange & Charm Quarks

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Sorting virtual quarks by mass, I noticed a heavier pair in the Spectrometer's readout. The charm quark took experimentalists by surprise in 1974; it took me by surprise too, until the helium cooled them enough to keep.

Made in $(item)Particle Spectrometer$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Standard Model.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Bottom & Top Quarks, Empirical Notes II, Standard Model Matrix, Standard Model Singularity.

Quark matter laced with strange quarks, possibly more stable than ordinary nuclei. A drop of it converts any normal matter it touches into more of itself, given the chance. It is dense, dull and should be kept very far from everything.
pages.title: Strange Matter

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Witten's strange matter hypothesis haunted me as I ran Strange Matter Pellets through the Particle Spectrometer with quark-gluon plasma. The spectrum showed a third quark flavour dissolving into the mix and staying.
Made in $(item)Particle Spectrometer$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Hyperon Crystal, Pentaquark Shard, Standard Model Singularity.

Supersymmetry pairs every boson with a fermion and every fermion with a boson. The lightest such partner, the neutralino, would be stable, invisible and heavy: an ideal candidate for dark matter. The shard is almost weightless in light but seems far heavier when you try to move it.
pages.title: Superpartner Shard

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Colliding the Standard Model matrix with dark matter through a dark matter lens, I searched for something that interacted only weakly. A heavy neutral partner appeared, and it matched dark matter perfectly.
Made in $(item)Quark-Gluon Collider$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Supersymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dimensional Residue, Grand Unified Core, Standard Model Singularity.

A crystal grown from hypothetical faster-than-light particles. Tachyons would have imaginary mass, slowing down as they gain energy and never dropping below light speed, and in some frames they would arrive before they left. Holding it, I occasionally feel its weight a moment before I pick it up.
pages.title: Tachyon Crystal

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Tachyon Resonator, Cherenkov light passed through a Void Lattice Shard and came out early. Cooling the output in superfluid helium, I caught crystals that existed before I flipped the switch. Bulk monoliths hold a few, inexplicably.

Made in $(item)Tachyon Resonator$().$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Bulk Monolith chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Tachyonics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Causal Solder, Causality Loop Engine, Chrono Loom, Chronon Capacitor, Chronon Field Inverter, Chronon Gas, Chronoplastic Casing, Hyperon Crystal and more.

A thin stream of faster-than-light particles. Because their mass is imaginary, they speed up as they lose energy, so the coldest flux is also the fastest. It arrives in the pipe a fraction of a moment before I open the valve.
pages.title: Tachyon Flux

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Pumping tachyon crystal with superfluid helium in the Tachyon Resonator, I drained energy from the cavity and the readings jumped ahead of the clock. Faster-than-light particles, slowing by speeding up.
Made in $(item)Tachyon Resonator$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Tachyonics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Chronon Capacitor, Chronon Gas, Imaginary Unit, Lorentz Transform Crystal, Temporal Singularity.

A microwave amplifier whose electron beam has been replaced with tachyons. It drives RF cavities from slightly in the future, so the wave is already there when each bunch arrives. It hums with a pitch that starts before it is switched on.
pages.title: Tachyon Klystron

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)My cavities lagged behind the beam. In the Tachyon Resonator I wound a superconducting coil around a quantum dot in helium, sending tachyons through. The drive signal now arrives a little early.
Made in $(item)Tachyon Resonator$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Chronal Accelerator, Empirical Notes II, RF Accelerating Cavity.

The two lightest quark flavours, carrying charges of plus two-thirds and minus one-third. Two ups and a down make a proton; two downs and an up make a neutron; so nearly every atom ever touched is built from these. Confinement means they never appear alone, and the pair sits in the palm with a stubborn, sticky pull.
pages.title: Up & Down Quarks

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Virtual quarks from the Quantum Foam vanish almost as soon as they appear. Running them through the Particle Spectrometer under superfluid helium, I could sort them by mass, and the two lightest flavours came out first and most often.

Made in $(item)Particle Spectrometer$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Standard Model.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Antiquark Shard, Empirical Notes III, Primordial Nucleosynthesis Ash, Standard Model Matrix, Standard Model Singularity.

What is left of a Void Wraith: a little pocket of nothing that refuses to be filled. Light falls into it and does not come out; air slides around it. It feels like a cold hole in my hand, and it is lighter than nothing.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): dropped by the Void Wraith.
pages.title: Void Essence

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The first Void Wraith I defeated left this behind, a small region of emptiness the air would not enter. I scooped it into a jar and it stayed there, quietly refusing everything.

Made in $(item)Dark Matter Halo Collector$().$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Void Wraith.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Dark Sector.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Contained Anomaly Specimen, Dark Matter Lens, Empty Set.
Hull plating for a warp field forge. An Alcubierre bubble would need negative energy density in its walls, which is what makes this casing exotic.
pages.title: Warp Forge Casing

pages.text: Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Dark Sector.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Warp Field Forge.

A localised bump made by adding waves of slightly different frequencies so they reinforce in one place and cancel elsewhere. Quantum particles are wave packets, which is why their position and momentum cannot both be sharp. The packet seems to spread slowly the longer you watch it.
pages.title: Wave Packet

pages.text: $(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Adding up a Fourier series of entangled photon modes in the Analytic Continuator, I built a pulse of light localised in space. Its spread in frequency and position balanced exactly as Heisenberg said.
Made in $(item)Analytic Continuator$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Quantum Field Lattice, Quantum Singularity.
Separates a spray of particles by mass and charge: quark flavours, leptons and gauge bosons, one by one.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
pages.title: Particle Spectrometer

pages.text: Real spectrometers work on the same idea: a magnetic field bends a charged particle's path, and how sharply it curves gives away its momentum and charge. Light particles swing wide, heavy ones barely turn. Mine sorts the spray into labelled bins.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 3 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Gauge Boson Cluster, Lepton Triplet, Strange & Charm Quarks, Strange Matter, Up & Down Quarks.
Made in a crafting grid.
A ring accelerator that smashes heavy nuclei into quark-gluon plasma.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
pages.title: Quark-Gluon Collider

pages.text: Quarks are never seen alone - the strong force pulls harder the further apart they get. But smash heavy nuclei together hard enough and, for an instant, protons and neutrons melt into a soup of free quarks and gluons: the universe as it was a microsecond after the Big Bang.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

pages.name: Quark-Gluon Collider
pages.text: Cycling blocks: any of them fits (Interface Ports, higher coil/emitter tiers). Rotate, zoom and view layers in $(thing)JEI$().

$(thing)Machine data$(): a multiblock (16 item and 16 fluid inputs, 4 and 4 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Baryon Asymmetry Crystal, Dark Matter, Magnetic Monopole, Quark-Gluon Plasma, Strange Matter, Strange Matter Pellet, Superpartner Shard.
Made in a crafting grid.
$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Quark-Gluon Collider$(): Hyperion Synchrotron

Day 96. The $(item)Particle Spectrometer$() splits quark-gluon plasma into $(item)quark flavours$(), $(item)leptons$() and $(item)gauge bosons$(). The heaviest quarks and the $(item)Higgs$() need the Synchrotron.

The $(thing)Standard Model$() is our best account of matter: six quarks, six leptons, the gauge bosons that carry the forces, and the Higgs, whose field gives particles their mass. It is astonishingly accurate, and plainly incomplete - it has no gravity and no dark matter.

All of them together make the $(item)Standard Model Matrix$(). The Collider turns it and dark matter into $(item)Superpartner Shards$(), and the Tesseract Assembler unifies everything into a $(item)Grand Unified Core$().$(br2)Correction to my earlier notes: the Higgs Catalyst now needs a real Higgs boson.
Every known particle in one lattice. It explains almost everything - except gravity and dark matter.$(br2)Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().
An excitation of the field that gives everything its mass, frozen before it could decay.$(br2)Made in $(item)Hyperion Synchrotron$().

Lesson learned the expensive way. Processes cooled by $(fluid)Superfluid Helium$() hand it back as $(fluid)Warm Helium$(). Recondense it in a $(item)Bose-Einstein Condenser$() or the $(item)Fractionation Spire$() - or you will run out. Below about 2 K helium flows with no friction at all; a little warmer and it is just a cold liquid.

High-tier processes leave $(fluid)Dimensional Residue$(). The $(item)Fractionation Spire$() splits it into Dark Matter, Exotic Matter, Inflaton Field and Chronon Gas. Nothing is waste if you can separate it.

$(item)Spacetime Slag$() can be sorted by a $(item)Maxwell's Demon$() for Void Lattice and, rarely, Planck Shards. Maxwell dreamed up his demon in 1867: a tiny doorkeeper sorting fast molecules from slow, seeming to cheat the second law. Mine sorts rubble.

A chemist's catalyst speeds a reaction and comes out unchanged at the end. These behave the same way: present, necessary, never used up. Since each is forged from the one before, I treat the first one as the most precious thing in the lab.

Some things are not made in a machine: they are $(thing)converged$(). Place a $(item)Convergence Altar$() and up to twelve $(item)Resonance Pedestals$() around it (within 4 blocks, at most one block higher or lower). Put the core item on the altar and one item on each pedestal - JEI shows which.

Power the altar (it takes energy from any side), then right-click it with an empty hand or give it a $(thing)redstone pulse$(). Beams run from the pedestals; when it finishes, the pedestals are empty and the core has become the result. Take it off with an empty hand (sneak-click takes the core back instead).
Bigger rituals need better pedestals: $(item)Harmonic$() (grade 2) and $(item)Absolute$() (grade 3) pedestals carry what a Resonance Pedestal cannot. Every pedestal in use must be good enough.

Automating it is the trick: pipes may put the core onto the altar and take the result off, and every pedestal takes exactly one item from a pipe (it refuses more, and locks while in use). A comparator reads 15 from the altar when a result waits, 7 while it works. The $(item)Engineering Components$() are all made here.
Much later the $(item)Convergence Engine$() runs every convergence recipe as an ordinary machine, at four times the energy.
Does in a box what the Convergence Altar does with pedestals and patience: every convergence ritual, fed by pipes like any machine.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 6$() machine.

pages.text: Real chips start the same way. A seed crystal is dipped into a melt and drawn slowly upward (the $(thing)Czochralski process$()), and atoms line up behind it into one unbroken lattice - a $(thing)boule$(). In industry a single defect can ruin a wafer, so I do not rush the vat.
